title: Market shrank
evidence: Own revenue Q4→Q1 (DB): 8 of 12 SBUs grew — portfolio +67.5 Cr; only Ispat (−82), Asphalt (−17), Commodities (−10), ACEL (−0.8) shrank.
National market grew (web): steel +15% CAGR, food/edible-oil imports +16%, telecom +4.3%.
verdict_note: Market did not shrink. The drop is share-loss (4 SBUs) + margin (8 SBUs), not a contracting market.

title: Competitor won on price/offer
evidence: Competitor price/offer recovered (oms.tblCompetitorPriceHeader+Row numAvgMarketOffer): Ispat 172, Essentials 194, Cement 271 headers (2024-25).
Named leaders (web): BSRM ~30% steel, Meghna edible oil, Grameenphone 45.6% telecom.
verdict_note: Competitor price/offer now in DB for Ispat/Essentials. Regional competitor volume (C2) not found — it is Marketing field data, not in any ERP table.

title: Sales team did not engage
evidence: Team was equipped: KPI targets exist (Essentials 32,194, Ispat 5,753) and beat routes exist (Essentials 6,695).
622 dealers churned (Q4 buyers with zero Q1 orders).
Actual calls unverifiable: oms.tblViciDialApiCallLog last entry 28-Aug-2025.
verdict_note: Equipped but unverifiable. Actual cause of missing data: the ViciDial call-center feed stopped 28-Aug-2025 — no Q1 call log exists in the DB.

title: Sales team instability
evidence: Attrition now measured (PeopleDesk saas.empEmployeeSeparation): 2,248 separations — 951 in 2026, 796 in 2025, 487 in 2024.
Headcount 19,008 (saas.empEmployeeBasicInfo).
SBU plans self-report: Logistics needs 4 salesmen, Infotech replace/hire 4 KAM, Mediplex team abolished then rebuilt.
verdict_note: Attrition is real and rising (951 separations YTD 2026) — corroborates the self-reported instability.

title: Supply / service failure
evidence: Short-supply now quantified (oms.tblSalesOrderRow numUndeliveryValues, Q1): Ispat 65.4 Cr, Ready Mix 41.3 Cr, Essentials 18.1 Cr ≈ 127.8 Cr undelivered.
Stock transactions 3.16M (wms.tblInventoryTransactionHeader) across 7 loss SBUs.
SBU notes: ACEL zero stock, Essentials RM shortage, Asphalt LC-bitumen, Commodities no LC approval, Ispat BMRE shutdown.
verdict_note: Strongest cause, now quantified: ~127.8 Cr of orders short-supplied in Q1 (revenue scale, not loss).

title: Credit policy pushed dealers away
evidence: AR now pullable (fin GL 1120001): Essentials 261k rows, Ispat 101k.
Infotech root cause: overdue receivables + credit restrictions; Next JobZ: DSO 60→45, concentration 26%.
verdict_note: AR data available. Actual cause of the remaining gap: the credit-BLOCKED customer list needs the prt.tblBusinessPartner credit-limit join (not yet pulled).

title: Product / quality issue
evidence: No quality complaint in any SBU root-cause note.
Complaints table (prt.tblSiteComplainInfo) has Ready Mix only.
verdict_note: No evidence in submitted plans or complaint data.

title: Margin-driven loss
evidence: Telecom GP −36.6%; Commodities 8.0%; Logistics 2.8%; Asphalt 5.2%.
Essentials + Ispat = 32.11 Cr of the 55.77 Cr total loss.
CM% now computed and fixed cost pulled for all 12 SBUs (break-even in Q2 outlook).
verdict_note: Confirmed with full CM% + fixed-cost base (was GP-only).

title: Went silent in market
evidence: Marketing spend now pullable (fin GL 4210001): Essentials 5.58 Cr, Ispat 5.53 Cr in Q1.
verdict_note: Q1 marketing spend available. Actual cause of the remaining gap: Q4→Q1 spend-change needs the Q4 GL pull (Q1 is available).
